name: Announcements
description: One message to every user on the right channels (docs/phases/47-announcements): the platform operator to every tenant (chosen tenants, roles, plans, editions), a tenant admin to their own workspace. Popup (acknowledged once per person), toast, banner, the bell, mail, push and SMS; text per language with a fallback; send now or scheduled, expiry, withdraw; a send that keeps failing is given up, its sender told, and retried or withdrawn by hand; numbers per announcement. Maintenance windows make their own planned and unplanned notices on it.
author: Kuray Karaaslan

permissions.name: Send announcements
permissions.description: Compose, schedule, send, test, retry and withdraw announcements and edit maintenance notices. In the root tenant it reaches every tenant (behind the platform admin gate); elsewhere the workspace's own members. High impact: a send can mail every user.

permissions.name: See announcements
permissions.description: See the announcements meant for oneself in the shell (popup, banner, toast) and acknowledge them.

extensionPoints.description: An audience axis of a platform announcement that another module knows (D18): the contribution's `key` is the facet id the audience stores its values under (`plan`: tenant_subscription, the tenants whose live subscription is on a chosen plan; `edition`: module_lifecycle, the tenants using an active module of a chosen edition), `metadata.label` its name in the composer. Default export: { options() => Promise<{ value, label }[]>, tenantsMatching(values) => Promise<tenantId[]> } (AudienceFacetProvider in server/announcement.types.ts). The composer lists every facet's options; a send narrows its tenants to those that match ANY value of each facet it uses. Fails CLOSED for a facet in use: when its provider cannot answer, the count and the send are refused (503) rather than reaching people the sender meant to leave out. Platform gate: the facets describe tenants across the platform. With no contribution, the composer offers no facet.

Which addresses another module already mails about the same maintenance moment, so a person gets ONE mail (docs/phases/47-announcements B): asked before a maintenance notice of a tenant's window goes out by mail at its start or end, with the addresses it would mail. Default export: { coveredAddresses({ tenantId, windowId, stage: 'start' | 'end', emails }) => Promise<string[]> } (MailCoverageProvider in server/announcement.types.ts), a subset of `emails`, which the notice then leaves out of its mail (the bell, banner and toast still reach them). observability contributes its status-page subscribers, mailed at a window's start and end. Best-effort: a provider that fails covers nobody and the notice mails everyone it would.
